# Cncf Nhn Kubernetes Service Nks Reviewer

Review NHN Kubernetes Service (NKS) using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. NKS(NHN Kubernetes Service) is a managed Kubernetes service that allows you to easily deploy a Kubernetes cluster in NHN Cloud.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
